items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Jewish name, Chaim, and all that, the same.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know that -- let me see, what happened? We were in Philadelphia, and some girl I knew came into the hotel somewhere and asked for me, or called me, Is Hymie -- Hymie! You know. Because Herman -- Hymie, in

Jewish, you know, think it's Herman, and Hymie, and Jewish name, Chaim, and all that, the same. So they started calling me Hymie! And Fats picked it up. He started calling me Hymie and on a lot of the recording dates, Hymie! I said what do you want?
So I used to get a lot of mail, Hymie.
